categories.main_business_segments: JenKem Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of medical and pharmaceutical polyethylene glycol (PEG) and its active derivatives. The company also provides innovative PEG pharmaceutical application technology services to downstream customers and independently develops PEG-modified drugs and Class III medical devices. Its main revenue currently comes from high-purity, low-dispersity medical and pharmaceutical PEG derivatives, with innovative drugs and medical devices still in development without revenue.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses proprietary PEG synthesis and PEGylation technologies enabling high-purity (>99%) and low-dispersity PEG raw materials production under cGMP standards. It has mastered first, second, and third-generation PEG derivative modification technologies, including branched and Y-shaped PEGs. Production involves precise control of polymerization parameters to minimize impurities. The company also develops lipid nanoparticle (LNP) delivery systems for nucleic acid drugs and maintains a technology matrix with dozens of innovative lipid compounds protected by patents.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic and international pharmaceutical companies, biotechnology firms, and medical device manufacturers. The company supports over 30 domestic PEG-modified drugs in clinical trials and 10 overseas innovative drug companies with clinical-stage products. Its products serve downstream applications in protein drug modification, small molecule drugs, antibody drugs, nucleic acid drug delivery, and PEG-based medical devices. Major markets include China, the US, Europe, and other international regions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production facilities in Beijing, Tianjin, and Liaoning, and has a wholly-owned subsidiary in the United States (Dallas, Texas). Its sales and technology services cover domestic and overseas markets, including significant business in the US and Europe. Overseas revenue accounts for over 60% of total revenue, with ongoing adjustments in customer structure favoring non-US international clients.
categories.supply_chain_position: JenKem operates upstream and midstream in the pharmaceutical supply chain by producing high-purity PEG raw materials and active derivatives used as key inputs for downstream drug and medical device manufacturers. It also provides technology services and custom development to downstream customers but does not engage in end-product sales of drugs or devices.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation in PEG synthesis, PEGylation chemistry, and drug delivery systems, including LNPs for nucleic acid therapeutics. It invests heavily in R&D, with over 35% of revenue allocated to research, focusing on advancing PEG-modified drugs through clinical trials and developing new medical devices. It aims to expand PEG applications in oncology, immunosuppression, and medical aesthetics while strengthening its patent portfolio and technology platforms.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of medical and pharmaceutical PEG derivatives and related technology service fees, including patent licensing, milestone payments, and royalties from downstream customers. The company also earns income from transportation services related to product delivery. It does not currently commercialize its own developed drugs or medical devices but plans to license or transfer these assets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: JenKem is a domestic leader and a major emerging global player in the high-purity, low-dispersity medical and pharmaceutical PEG derivatives market. It fills a long-standing domestic gap in large-scale production of high-quality PEG materials. The company competes internationally with established PEG suppliers and biotechnology firms, leveraging its proprietary technologies and comprehensive product portfolio to maintain a competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 227 million, a 22.26% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 29.8 million, down 74.22%. Despite revenue decline due to domestic order shortfalls and overseas inventory adjustments, the company increased R&D investment by 38.28% to nearly RMB 80 million. Total assets reached RMB 1.37 billion with stable cash flows, reflecting a mid-sized high-tech enterprise undergoing a performance adjustment phase.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: JenKem emphasizes its ability to produce high-purity, low-dispersity PEG raw materials and derivatives with excellent batch-to-batch consistency, meeting stringent pharmaceutical standards. Its proprietary PEGylation technologies enable customized solutions that improve drug stability, reduce toxicity, and extend half-life. The company’s integrated technology platforms and strong patent portfolio provide downstream clients with innovative, reliable materials and technical support, differentiating it as a trusted partner in biopharmaceutical innovation.
